_notes.too_new_days: Days before a post counts in medians. 0 for accounts we only have one export of, so their newest posts still count.
_notes.our_account: Our Instagram handle. Switch default_account to it once its first Media Tools export is imported.
_notes.words_per_minute: Narration pace used to estimate length. Re-measure once the voice is chosen.
_notes.elevenlabs: model is for finals and draft_model for cheap test takes (both have audio tags). credits_per_char matches ElevenLabs' plan allowances (v4 Turbo gets twice the characters); usd_per_1k is the API pay-as-you-go price (elevenlabs.io/pricing/api, checked 2026-10-20). voice_id is the default voice; set it from the web app's Voice page. tags are the audio tags scripts may use (knowledge/14-voice-tags.md).

eleven_v4_turbo.label: Eleven v4 Turbo (half price, for drafts)
